short: M06 ahead for 2012: earliest heard-speech spectrogram reconstruction from human ECoG in the ledger, above zero in all 15 patients; modulation result is a group effect; word readout uses one patient.
position: Among the ledger's pattern matches, the paper [@pasley2012] is the earliest reconstruction of heard speech from human intracranial recordings (M06); the authors claim the human-STG and modulation findings, not priority. The linear spectrogram reconstruction is ahead for 2012 and repeats per participant (above zero in all 15), while the read human priors classified syllable responses [@chang2010] or decoded formants during attempted production [@guenther2009]. The modulation-energy target rests on a group effect (F(1,14) = 33.36) and was reused only within its lineage. The evaluation (M12) is standard against the non-human reconstruction and fMRI identification priors the authors cite. The word readout overreaches: one participant, 47 candidates from one speaker, median rank 0.76, and a smoothing width with no stated selection set. No listener test is reported; [later] vocoder-parameter decoding reached 75% listener digit accuracy, 67% above a linear auditory-spectrogram baseline [@akbari2019].
